atoms.text: For hundreds of years slate has been mined in Wales. Slate mining in Wales has made lots of money for the country, and the creation of slate quarries has changed the landscape. Recently, six places in Gwynedd in North Wales have been awarded the UNESCO Slate Landscape Award. This award shows the significance of these historical quarries.

What did the mining of slate do to Wales?
What award has been given to the quarries?

atoms.text: The slate industry has existed in Wales since the Roman period. It experienced rapid growth during the industrial revolution. At one point Penrhyn was one of the largest slate quarries in the world. To symbolise the importance of the slate industry in Wales, the Millennium Centre, or canolfan y mileniwm, has been made using different colours of slate from all over Wales.
